user.title: SolarAssistant
user.description: Both authentication methods connect to your SolarAssistant unit on your local network.

local.title: Local password
local.description: Enter the IP/hostname of your unit and its web password. [How to find or set your web password](https://solar-assistant.io/help/access/password)

cloud.title: Cloud API key
cloud.description: Generate an API key at https://solar-assistant.io/user/edit#api and paste it below.

pick_site.title: Select a site
pick_site.description: Choose which site to add. Repeat the integration to add more.

search_site.title: Find your site
search_site.description: Your account has many sites. Enter a site name and submit to search, then select the match. Already-configured sites are hidden.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SolarAssistant unit. Check the host is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check the password or API key.
error.no_sites: Your SolarAssistant account has no sites attached.
error.no_sites_match: No matching site found. Type a name to search. Already-configured sites are hidden.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This SolarAssistant unit is already configured.
abort.not_ipv4: The unit was discovered on an address that is not IPv4.
abort.all_sites_configured: All sites on your account are already configured.

data_description.min_update_interval_s: The least time between two updates of one sensor, to cut recorder writes. A value that crosses zero updates at once. 0 turns the limit off.
data_description.stale_after_min: Each inverter and battery has a Data sensor that turns off when the device sent no changed value for this time. 0 turns the check off.
data_description.soc_spread_alert_pct: Battery SOC spread alert turns on when the largest pack SOC minus the smallest exceeds this.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the SolarAssistant unit to fetch its metric list.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error while fetching the metric list.

entry_not_found.message: No SolarAssistant entry has the ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The SolarAssistant entry {title} is not loaded.

not_a_setting.message: {topic} is no writable setting of this unit.

invalid_option.message: {value} is no option of {topic}. The options are: {options}.

topoff_disabled.message: Turn on the switch Battery top-off first.

topoff_failed.title: Battery top-off failed on {title}
topoff_failed.description: The battery top-off stopped with an error: {reason}. It waits for Start top-off, or for the switch Battery top-off to go off and on.

write_failed.title: A setting write failed on {title}
write_failed.description: SolarAssistant did not apply {topic} = {value}: {error}. The issue goes when a write of {topic} succeeds.

set_setting.name: Set setting
set_setting.description: Writes one setting of the inverter or the battery, and has the unit read it back until it holds.

topic.name: Topic
topic.description: The topic of the setting, such as inverter_1/grid_charge_current.

value.name: Value
value.description: The new value, as SolarAssistant writes it, such as 100 or Enabled.

start_topoff.name: Start top-off
start_topoff.description: Starts a battery top-off now, outside the window. The switch Battery top-off must be on.

stop_topoff.name: Stop top-off
stop_topoff.description: Stops a running battery top-off and writes back the saved settings.
